stanza: They'll love you when you're all alone
But you find a red rose in the morning light
You wait the night and find it gone

deserted.line: I am a man whose dreams have all deserted
stanza: In this proud land we grew up strong
I was taught to fight, taught to win
I never thought I could fail
No fight left or so it seems
I am a man whose dreams have all deserted
I've changed my face, I've changed my name
But no one wants you when you lose
